name: android-shell
description: BETOGO Android 壳（Capacitor，远程 URL 模式）

scripts.sync:ph: CAP_APP_ID=games.betogo.app CAP_MARKET=PH CAP_SERVER_URL=https://betogo.app cap sync android
scripts.sync:id: CAP_APP_ID=games.betogo.id CAP_MARKET=ID CAP_SERVER_URL=https://www.betogo.games cap sync android
scripts.apk:ph:debug: npm run sync:ph && cd android && ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/share/android-commandlinetools} ./gradlew assemblePhDebug
scripts.apk:ph:release: npm run sync:ph && cd android && ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/share/android-commandlinetools} ./gradlew assemblePhRelease
scripts.apk:id:debug: npm run sync:id && cd android && ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/share/android-commandlinetools} ./gradlew assembleIdDebug
scripts.apk:id:release: npm run sync:id && cd android && ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-/usr/local/share/android-commandlinetools} ./gradlew assembleIdRelease
